name: ideall
description: 基于 Rust 与 GPUI 的开源、本地优先个人信息终端

scripts.native:check: cd native && cargo check --locked --workspace --all-targets && cargo check --locked -p ideall-mobile --features mobile-ui-host-check
scripts.native:lint: cd native && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets --exclude ideall-mobile -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked -p ideall-mobile --features mobile-ui-host-check -- -D warnings
scripts.native:build:desktop: cd native && cargo build --locked --release -p ideall-desktop && bash scripts/package-desktop.sh
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:checks && pnpm native:lint && pnpm native:test
scripts.verify:checks: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint:actions && pnpm lint:docs && pnpm version:check && pnpm test:scripts
